findings.statement: Record check accepts a new MERGED whose gates{} is empty or whose evidence[] has no ci records: M then comes from ref and no CI evidence is checked. The premise (policy needs no CI evidence) is never verified, so the stated trust holder is bypassed (ADR-0010 p.2).
findings.recommendation: Require gates keys = gates of the transition in effective policy and a ci record per PASS L1 gate of MERGED; or list as residual risk next to ARCHIVED/ABANDONED.

findings.statement: Only roles and approvals[] are fixed to HEAD^1. The tree for policy paths (match.paths of factory-change), paths.src/paths.tests and the effective policy of the classification check is unstated; read from HEAD, a PR shrinking factory-change match.paths and editing packs/** passes spec and none rules.
findings.recommendation: State that policy paths, paths.* and the risk_level comparison use packs and warrant.json of HEAD^1; add a scenario with a PR shrinking match.paths.

findings.statement: SCN-VER-081 expects exit 0 with APPROVER_IS_AUTHOR for a PR with a new APPROVED; such a PR is kind impl with change_state APPROVED and gets CHANGE_NOT_VERIFYING, exit 1 (SCN-VER-090). WHEN lacks the VERIFYING context that makes 0 reachable.
findings.recommendation: Put the Change in VERIFYING with passing gates in WHEN, or assert only absence of REF_NOT_VERIFIED and presence of APPROVER_IS_AUTHOR.

findings.statement: REQ-SDD-005 adds .github/workflows/** because a PR workflow would replace the CI evidence producer. Job warrant installs the CLI from the PR checkout (design 8, npm i -g .), so packages/cli/src/** does the same yet is no policy path: a feature impl-PR can alter warrant ci or checks and get a verified green run.
findings.recommendation: Add packages/cli/src/** and package manifests to factory-change, or run the verdict with a CLI built from HEAD^1, or record as residual risk in Non-Goals.

findings.statement: ci output shape data{... evidence[]? ...} does not define evidence[] (records written in impl or verified in archive) and omits dry_run and would_write[] required by --dry-run.
ci fetch adds ids to the manifest by REQ-VER-001, which updates manifest.commit and versions on each write; the value for imported records (HEAD, M^2 or the record) is unstated.
ci fetch promises nothing written on input errors, but an IO failure mid-import and a concurrent ci fetch or check on the same Change (lock, BUSY) are not described.
warrant ci rejects WARRANT_STATE_DIR, but ci fetch writes to <state>: with the variable set, records land outside .warrant and the archive-PR cannot carry them; no USAGE or hint.
Candidates are run attempts, but listRuns in design 6 returns runs with their latest attempt; an earlier successful attempt on tree M needs a per-attempt lookup not shown in ForgePort.

assumptions.statement: Gates of VERIFYING->MERGED taken from packs/core-sdd profiles: branch-isolated is only on APPROVED->IMPLEMENTING, so detached HEAD in CI does not affect the impl verdict.

Round-6 fixes F-1..F-8 (classification, repeat archive only with ARCHIVED, M from ref, first-parent spec-PR merge, frozen record, WARRANT_STATE_DIR USAGE, attempt 1 default, current-attempt kinds) are present in the delta text; no regression found.
